All 15 useful supported targets have at least one useful same-obligation source: 15/21 targets in the useful-source groups are useful, versus 0/100 with only unnecessary sources. At the primary distinct source-target/obligation pair level, useful sources point to useful targets in 21/29 pairs, versus 4/189 for unnecessary sources. All seven beneficial local pairs, including the sole strong beneficial, lie in useful-source groups. The strong event has one REQUIRED source at lexical rank 2. Most broad-support noise is associated with only unnecessary sources (100/106 unnecessary targets), but useful sources still support six unnecessary targets and two harmful local pairs. This consistent descriptive separation makes source credibility worth investigating prospectively. It establishes association, not causation or a deployable gold filter, and does not amend the completed Stage D result.
